import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static long mod;

    static long pw(long a, long e) {
        if (e <= 0) return 1;
        long x = pw(a, e / 2);
        x = x * x % mod;
        return (e % 2 == 1) ? x * a % mod : x;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int M = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        long[] fac = new long[N + 1];
        long[] inv = new long[N + 1];
        fac[0] = 1;
        inv[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % mod;
            inv[i] = inv[i - 1] * pw(i, mod - 2) % mod;
        }

        long[] cnt = new long[M + 1];
        long[] sum = new long[M + 1];
        cnt[0] = 1;
        for (int m = 1; m <= M; m++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                long cl = cnt[k] * inv[k] % mod;
                long cr = cnt[m - 1 - k] * inv[m - 1 - k] % mod;
                long sl = sum[k] * inv[k] % mod;
                long sr = sum[m - 1 - k] * inv[m - 1 - k] % mod;
                cnt[m] += cl * cr % mod * (m + 1);
                sum[m] += (cl * sr + sl * cr) % mod * (m + 1);
                sum[m] += cl * cr % mod * (k * (k + 1) + (m - k) * (m - k - 1)) / 2 % mod;
            }
            cnt[m] = cnt[m] % mod * fac[m - 1] % mod;
            sum[m] = sum[m] % mod * fac[m - 1] % mod;
        }

        long[][] cnt_ans = new long[N + 1][M + 1];
        long[][] sum_ans = new long[N + 1][M + 1];
        cnt_ans[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= Math.min(i, M); j++) {
                cnt_ans[i][j] = cnt_ans[i - 1][j];
                sum_ans[i][j] = sum_ans[i - 1][j];
                if (j == i) {
                    cnt_ans[i][j] += cnt[i] * inv[i] % mod;
                    sum_ans[i][j] += sum[i] * inv[i] % mod;
                }
                for (int k = 1; k <= Math.min(j, i - 1); k++) {
                    long c = cnt[k] * inv[k] % mod;
                    long s = sum[k] * inv[k] % mod;
                    cnt_ans[i][j] += cnt_ans[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c % mod;
                    sum_ans[i][j] += (sum_ans[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c + cnt_ans[i - 1 - k][j - k] * s) % mod;
                }
                cnt_ans[i][j] %= mod;
                sum_ans[i][j] %= mod;
            }
        }

        long ans = sum_ans[N][M] * fac[M] % mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
